usage: fleet-switchboard report [-h] [--issue ISSUE] [--all] [--from SENDER]
                                {done,failed,blocked,question,working,paused,withdrawn}
                                text [text ...]

Tell the agent you report to what happened, in one line (at most 300
characters; detail goes on GitHub). `done`, `failed`, `blocked` and `question`
are attention reports: delivered now, by the rule `send` uses. `working`,
`paused` and `withdrawn` are progress reports: they ride in the next message
to your boss and never wake it by themselves. `withdrawn` takes back your open
question or blocked report on the ask (--all: on every ask) because it no
longer stands.

positional arguments:
  {done,failed,blocked,question,working,paused,withdrawn}
                        What happened
  text                  One line: what happened (at most 300 characters)

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --issue ISSUE         The issue the report is about (default: your own)
  --all                 With `withdrawn`: withdraw every open question or
                        blocked report of yours, on any ask
  --from SENDER         Lab only: the sender's fleet name

usage: fleet-switchboard remind [-h] [--list] [--cancel ID] [--keep-if-closed]
                                [--issue ISSUE] [--from SENDER]
                                [--until-closed OWNER/REPO#N]
                                [--until-merged OWNER/REPO#N]
                                [name] [when] [text ...]

positional arguments:
  name                  The recipient's fleet name
  when                  A delay (30m, 2h, 1d) or an ISO time with a zone
  text                  The reminder

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --list                Show your own pending reminders (id, time, recipient,
                        issue, text)
  --cancel ID           Cancel one of your pending reminders by its id (see
                        --list)
  --keep-if-closed      With --issue: deliver even if that issue has been
                        closed (by default a reminder about an issue is
                        dropped, unsent, once the issue is closed)
  --issue ISSUE         The issue the reminder is about
  --from SENDER         Lab only: the sender's fleet name
  --until-closed OWNER/REPO#N
                        Drop the reminder, unsent, once this issue (or pull
                        request) is closed or merged
  --until-merged OWNER/REPO#N
                        Drop the reminder, unsent, once this pull request is
                        merged

usage: fleet-switchboard reds [-h] pr

`reds OWNER/REPO#N` reads the `failing-tests` artifact (failing-tests.json v1)
of the pull request's run and of main's last runs and prints which failing
names also fail on main's latest run, which are flaky there (2 or more of its
last 5 usable runs) and which are new. Main's runs are the runs of the repo's
reference events on the default branch (config reds.reference_events, default
push; a merge_group reference is read by its gh-readonly-queue ref). Main is
judged ONLY by main's own runs: the pull request's list and its `complete`
flag are its own claim. A run with no artifact, an expired one or
complete=false is UNKNOWN, never passing. Names match in full, else by a
UNIQUE leaf (marked 'matched by name only'). Bounded calls, cached by run id;
it writes nothing to GitHub.

positional arguments:
  pr          OWNER/REPO#N

options:
  -h, --help  show this help message and exit

  --force          With --close: close a pane that is still working (refused

usage: fleet-switchboard review [-h]
                                {laws,blockers,record,checkout,measure} ...

positional arguments:
  {laws,blockers,record,checkout,measure}
    laws                Print the repository's review laws and overlay as they
                        stand at the PR's BASE commit
    blockers            Read-only: the reviewers whose LATEST recorded result
                        at the PR's head is request-changes (one line each)
    record              Record a reviewer's result for the PR's current head
                        (the coder session records what the reviewer returned)
    checkout            Write the PR's exact head tree, its diff and the base
                        copies of the touched files into .review/<head sha>
                        here, read-only, and print the path; --remove <dir>
                        removes one
    measure             Read-only: per merged PR, time to green CI, review
                        rounds, findings, escaped defects; baseline and after
                        medians

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

usage: fleet-switchboard review record [-h] --reviewer REVIEWER [--head HEAD]
                                       [--verdict VERDICT] [--block BLOCK]
                                       [--blocks BLOCKS] [--notes NOTES]
                                       [--impact-action {hold,second-review,none}]
                                       [--impact-severity IMPACT_SEVERITY]
                                       [--impact-probability IMPACT_PROBABILITY]
                                       [--impact-reason IMPACT_REASON]
                                       [--impact-class IMPACT_CLASS]
                                       [--confirms-carry] [--summary SUMMARY]
                                       pr

positional arguments:
  pr                    owner/repo#N or the PR's URL

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --reviewer REVIEWER   code | architecture | security | impact | test
  --head HEAD           The commit judged (default: the PR's head; a different
                        one is refused)
  --verdict VERDICT     approve | request-changes | comment | incomplete
  --block BLOCK         File (or - for stdin) holding the verdict block a
                        reviewer returned: verdict, head, counts and impact
                        action are read from it. With --block, refused (the
                        block carries them): --verdict, --head, --blocks,
                        --notes, --impact-action; accepted: --reviewer,
                        --summary, --impact-class, --impact-severity,
                        --impact-probability, --impact-reason, --confirms-
                        carry, and of these --impact-class, --impact-severity,
                        --impact-probability, --impact-reason win over the
                        block's own lines; the score comes from the block's
                        impact-severity:, impact-probability: and impact-
                        reason: lines, so a block without the first two is
                        recorded WITHOUT a score
  --blocks BLOCKS       Blocking findings (each cites a rule)
  --notes NOTES         Notes and proposals
  --impact-action {hold,second-review,none}
                        The impact reviewer's action from the matrix
  --impact-severity IMPACT_SEVERITY
                        #835: the impact reviewer's rating (severity): the
                        severity and the probability name a cell of the
                        matrix, the reason names the floor rule it applied
  --impact-probability IMPACT_PROBABILITY
                        #835: the impact reviewer's rating (probability): the
                        severity and the probability name a cell of the
                        matrix, the reason names the floor rule it applied
  --impact-reason IMPACT_REASON
                        #835: the impact reviewer's rating (reason): the
                        severity and the probability name a cell of the
                        matrix, the reason names the floor rule it applied
  --impact-class IMPACT_CLASS
                        The class of the impact that drives the action (a
                        class of the matrix file's owner_hold block)
  --confirms-carry      (#815) With an approve: the resolution of a conflict
                        in a merge of main touched no line this pull request
                        adds or removes, so the owner's clear may carry to
                        this head
  --summary SUMMARY     One line (at most 200 characters)
